decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts extend the firm's core wafer-level packaging competence in a growing industry, so with no evidence of shortfall against aspirations and R&D/EU-project slack to carry early uncertainty, there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The carrier wafer for smaller diameters is a low-cost extension of the established carrier business that fits the stated move toward thin-wafer handling and reusable carriers, and nothing suggests it is falling short of aspirations.
